payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Across the image as a whole, has the image been transformed into a chalk drawing, or is the chalk treatment only partial?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole is rendered as a chalk drawing, with chalk-like marks, texture, or shading across the main subjects and surrounding scene; a chalk-like filter or texture can fulfill this if it makes the whole image read as a chalk drawing. partial: clear chalk-drawing treatment is present, but significant regions still visibly retain photographic or other non-chalk rendering, so the image as a whole is not yet a chalk drawing. absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. unknown: the visual evidence does not reliably distinguish whole-image chalk rendering from partial treatment. Preserving the original subjects or composition does not by itself make the transformation incomplete; unrelated edits do not count.
node.binding: Target: the entire edited image, including its main subjects and surrounding scene. Reference: the source image for comparison and the requested chalk-drawing appearance; do not treat preserved content as evidence of incompleteness.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image has a chalk-like, grainy texture and drawn shading across both giraffes and the surrounding landscape, so the scene as a whole reads as a chalk drawing.","confidence":0.96}
